mechanism: Ketorolac reduces renal blood flow and glomerular filtration rate, impairing cefepime (renally eliminated) clearance and increasing nephrotoxicity risk, particularly in volume-depleted or elderly patients.
action: Monitor serum creatinine and renal function closely; consider alternative analgesia or reduce ketorolac duration; ensure adequate hydration and verify cefepime dosing is appropriate for renal function.
